target.title: fix(gateway-protocol): trim connect error detail codes in readConnectErrorDetailCode
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Gateway connect-error payloads can carry padded `details.code` strings (leading/trailing whitespace). `readConnectErrorDetailCode()` previously returned the raw string after only checking `code.trim().length > 0`, so strict comparisons against `ConnectErrorDetailCodes.*` failed and downstream helpers (`readPairingConnectErrorDetails`, `formatConnectErrorMessage`) fell back to generic messages.

## Why This Change Was Made

Return `code.trim()` from `readConnectErrorDetailCode()` so normalized detail codes match canonical constants and structured formatting paths run for untrusted gateway error details.

## User Impact

Control UI and other gateway clients show correct pairing-required and protocol-mismatch messages when the server sends padded detail codes, instead of generic fallback text.

## Evidence

- Unit regressions in `packages/gateway-protocol/src/connect-error-details.test.ts`
- Direct oxlint on touched gateway-protocol files
- ClawSweeper reviewed the exact behavior path and marked `proof: sufficient`
